waypoints.name: Andermatt base reset
waypoints.advice: Andermatt is where the day begins. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Oberalppass high road, climbing 600 m.

waypoints.name: Oberalppass high road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2044 m here. The road climbs 600 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 9 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Disentis food stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Disentis food stop
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 914 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Vorderrhein valley flow, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Vorderrhein valley flow
waypoints.advice: Vorderrhein valley flow, late in the day at 650 m. You lose 480 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Back to Chur.

waypoints.name: Back to Chur
waypoints.advice: Back at Back to Chur. That is the ride.

sections.advice: Andermatt base reset → Oberalppass high road climbs about 600 m in 8 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Furka-Grimsel-Susten Pass Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 33 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 59 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.story: 169 km one way from Andermatt - plan on about 3 h 13 of riding. The stops in between: Disentis and Vorderrhein valley flow. Oberalppass high road is the high point. It tops out at 2,044 m. The passes are the reason to go.
